answer: Work-slot deposit burn keeps fakes off the ledge. Each slot holds one deposit: 60 POA bridges one wallet to one slot. Each epoch every slot must echo a signed proof of work; a silent slot, or one echoing a copied proof, burns its whole 60 POA deposit. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 60,000 POA, all burned on first audit. An honest agent pays one deposit once and keeps working, so honesty costs one share while fakery pays for every slot.
